parts.text: [Caroline]: Realizing I can be me without fear and having the courage to transition was the best part. It's so freeing to express myself authentically and have people back me up.
[Melanie]: That's awesome, Caro! You've found the courage to be yourself - that's important for our mental health and finding peace.
[Caroline]: Thanks, Melanie! Been a long road, but I'm proud of how far I've come. How're you doing finding peace?
[Melanie]: I'm getting there, Caroline. Creativity and family keep me at peace.
[Caroline]: That's awesome, Melanie! How have your family been supportive during your move?
[Melanie]: My fam's been awesome - they helped out and showed lots of love and support.
[Caroline]: Wow, Mel, family love and support is the best!
[Melanie]: Yeah, Caroline, my family's been great - their love and support really helped me through tough times. It's awesome! We even went on another camping trip in the forest.
